instruction: Candid sports photograph, medium close-up of two women celebrating on an indoor badminton court. On the left, the blonde woman in a white t-shirt (R1) is seen from behind, jumping with her ponytail flying upward. On the right, the smiling brunette woman with a white headband and purple t-shirt (R2) faces her. They clasp hands high in a celebratory gesture. The background shows the red court under bright overhead lights.
